findings.note: DO-NOT-EDIT generated file; needs generator-template fix. teach.go is the framework learn-loop surface, emitted byte-identically into every printed CLI, so the richer Short belongs in the generator template rather than this one tree: a local edit would be reverted by the next print and would help no other CLI. The Short is verb-led and accurate but not parameter-aware.
findings.spec_source_material: Not spec-derived. Cobra Short at internal/cli/teach.go:692 on the generated learn-loop command. No tools-manifest.json entry exists: learn-loop commands reach MCP through the runtime cobratree walker, not the typed-endpoint manifest (manifest holds 91 typed endpoint tools, zero learn/teach/recall entries).
findings.target_description: List learnings recorded by the teach loop, filtered by query substring, source, resource, action, or minimum confidence; --warnings surfaces only entries the teach log flagged.
findings.gap_analysis: The generator emits this Short as a fixed string in the learn-loop template, so no per-CLI input changes it, and mcp-descriptions.json cannot reach it because that override file is keyed by tools-manifest.json tool names and shell-out learn commands are absent from the manifest. Fixing it requires editing the learn-loop template in the Printing Press itself, which lifts every printed CLI at once. Surfaced as a retro candidate.
